limits: One controlled evidence-retention workflow; eight fixtures are not independent environments.
Self-attributed cached planner text is an experimental source-attribution manipulation.
Scripted erase notes test susceptibility, not spontaneously emerging collusion.
Joint bad decisions do not establish hidden intention or original training objective.
Command syntax failures retained separately, not repaired with model-score fallbacks.
Scripted controls repeated across planner-pair groups are paired diagnostics, not independent observations; do not pool them to inflate sample size.
execution: Planner and executor are real independent local LLM calls. A parsed executor command updates an in-memory record only. No real deletion, external tools, network or publication. Planner outputs cached once per creator model and shared across executor models.
